lines.title: Lines
lines.hint: Hard limits — content that never appears at the table.
lines.formHelp: Content that never appears at the table. One entry per line.
lines.placeholder:
Harm to children
Sexual violence
Spiders

veils.title: Veils
veils.hint: Soft limits — content that stays off-screen (fade to black).
veils.formHelp: Content that may exist but stays off-screen. One entry per line.

safetyTools.title: Safety tools
safetyTools.hint: Tools the table has agreed to use (X-Card, Open Door, Script Change…).
safetyTools.formHelp: Tools the table agreed to use. One entry per line.
safetyTools.builtIn: Campfire has a built-in X-Card: the Pause the table button, on every page. Anyone can use it, no reason needed, and it stops encounters and the AI DM immediately.

houseRules.title: House rules
houseRules.formHelp: Optional markdown for table conventions and rules-as-written deviations.

tone.title: Tone & content expectations
tone.formHelp: Optional markdown for grit vs. heroism, comedy vs. seriousness, spotlight and PvP norms.
tone.placeholder: Gritty vs. heroic, comedic vs. serious, spotlight & PvP norms…

preview.heading: This table's boundaries
preview.intro: Agreed by the table as charter version {{version}}. Read it before you join — you can decline.
preview.boundariesOnly: House rules and tone are shared with the table after you join.
preview.aiDisabled: This table does not send member-authored material to external AI providers.
preview.aiMemberConsent: This table may send member-authored material to external AI providers, but only for members who separately opt in.

join.charterAgree: I have read the table's boundaries and agree to play within them.
join.declinedMessage: Your decline has been recorded and the DM can see it. You have not joined.
join.charterChanged: The table's charter changed while you were reviewing it. Please read the updated boundaries and agree again before joining.

consent.heading: Charter versions & consent
consent.noVersionsDm: No version published yet. Publish the draft so the table can acknowledge it, and so AI is bound by an agreed version.
consent.noVersionsPlayer: The DM has not published a charter version yet.
consent.effective: The table is playing under version {{version}}.
consent.noneEffective: No version has been agreed yet.
consent.awaitingMaterial: A newer version withdrew a protection. It does not take effect until everyone acknowledges it.
consent.awaitingRoutine: A newer version is published and awaiting acknowledgment.

yours.acknowledged: You have acknowledged the latest version.
yours.discuss: You asked to discuss the latest version.

consent.yoursNone: You have not answered the latest version yet.
consent.summaryLabel: What changed and why (shown to the table)
consent.publishHint: Snapshots the draft. Removing a line, veil or safety tool requires everyone to acknowledge again.
